title: Only 23 wild bison were left #Shorts
description:
By 1902 only 23 wild bison remained in Yellowstone, the last wild bison in North America. Today several thousand roam the park.

▶ Full documentary (Part 1, What's Really Under Yellowstone): https://youtu.be/-vkXqMrSljM
